newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage rose 1.40 million barrels in the week ended May 23 to 316.12 million barrels, the American Petroleum Institute said on Wednesday. This was up from a revised 314.72 million barrels the prior week, which was previously reported as 315.81 million.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) rose 1.27 million barrels in the week to 254.04 million barrels.
Distillate stocks rose 3.32 million barrels to 101.70 million barrels from 98.38 million the prior week.
API said PADD 1 distillate stocks rose 781,000 barrels to 33.23 million barrels.
It said gasoline production fell 25,000 barrels in the week to 7.93 million bpd from 7.96 million in the prior week.
Gasoline stocks fell 1.12 million barrels in the week to 196.78 million barrels from 197.90 million barrels the previous week.
Percent of stocks capacity fell to 96.7 percent from 97.6 percent the previous week.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) rose 1.35 million barrels to 37.79 million barrels from 36.44 million barrels the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units rose to 14.93 million barrels from 14.82 million the previous week.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week fell to 40.27 million barrels from 41.17 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports rose to 8.34 million barrels per day from 7.83 million, API said.
